With \(F=(0,20)\), point \(G\) divides \(CF\) in the ratio
\[
CG:GF=2:3.
\]
So
\[
G=C+\frac{2}{5}(F-C)
=(40,40)+\frac{2}{5}(0-40,20-40)
=(40,40)+\frac{2}{5}(-40,-20)
=(24,32).
\]
The area of \(\triangle BCG\), with \(B=(40,0)\), \(C=(40,40)\), \(G=(24,32)\), is
\[
\frac12 \cdot BC \cdot \text{distance from }G\text{ to }BC
=\frac12 \cdot 40 \cdot 16
=320.
\]

\[
\boxed{320}
\]
